title: Full-resolution compact-field 3DGS from random, Splat-SfM, and Beam initialization
question: Do the three paper paths execute from the same high-quality native-additive 2D Gaussian fields through a complete compact-field-supervised 3DGS fit with clone, split, and prune density control, and what qualitative failure signature remains specific to the Beam initialization?
hypothesis: Random and Splat-SfM initialization both converge to visibly detailed full-resolution reconstructions under the same compact objective and density schedule, while the unmodified Beam initialization exposes its known coverage, association, and scale problems despite receiving the identical downstream optimizer.
claim_boundary: Development integration and qualitative diagnosis on two outcome-exposed frames. The task can establish that the named code paths execute and expose their matched compact-field trajectories. It cannot establish paper quality, generalization, Original-3DGS or COLMAP performance, physical geometry, a VRAM advantage, a production default, or a causal Beam repair.

stage1_native_fullres.selection_basis: Outcome-exposed mechanism pilot on frame_00008/C0001; 5000x300 and 50000x1000 were rejected as visibly too soft before selecting 100000x2000.

three_path_initializer.selection_basis: Outcome-exposed mechanism construction on frame_00008 with no trained comparator outcomes used: the high-capacity fields yielded 3330 Splat-SfM tracks and at least 5000 Beam components, so all arms start from the exact common count 3330.

compact_3dgs.selection_basis: Rejected development diagnostic. Mechanism pilots rejected 5000 updates with density every 100 at only 12917 splats and rejected 5000 updates with density every 40 because the 68830-splat endpoint had only 2000 post-reset polish steps. The subsequent 10000-update sparse point run reached 100000 splats but remained visibly dark and soft at native resolution; it is not a paper endpoint.

development_visualization_only_standard_.selection_basis: Outside the protected compact claim: the outcome-exposed 10000-update sparse-point endpoint failed native-resolution visual QA. The repository's established 20260721 full reconstruction evidence uses the ordinary full-crop gsplat trainer for 30000 parent steps and already reached 34.9-36.0 dB fitted validation foreground PSNR for Random and Splat-SfM. The owner-requested development viewer therefore also exposes that current proven execution shape while replaying the new provider=native fields through the native additive renderer, never StructSplat or source RGB. Its dense generated crop tensors and SceneData/Trainer use make it ineligible for compact-arm or VRAM evidence.
development_visualization_only_standard_.teacher_replay: native additive crop tensor generated from sealed provider=native rtgsv

stages.label: Load sealed native-additive fields
stages.purpose: Load and hash the exact train and held-out full-resolution observation fields without decoding source images or masks.

stages.label: Construct the three initializations
stages.purpose: Build bounded-random, explicitly named Splat-SfM, and unmodified Beam Fusion candidates from the same train-only inputs and match their starting count.

stages.label: Run compact-field 3DGS with density control
stages.purpose: Optimize all 3DGS parameter families and SH bands while applying the same classic clone, split, prune, opacity-reset, hard-cap, and checkpoint schedule to every initialization.

stages.label: Evaluate held-out compact fields
stages.purpose: Evaluate exact held-out pixel and area risks, density trajectories, and saved native-resolution model renders without selecting from held-out outcomes.

stages.label: Build the three-model viewer
stages.purpose: Publish initial, checkpoint, and final models with explicit arm labels and full-resolution calibrated snapshots for qualitative inspection.

comparators.label: Bounded random initialization
comparators.purpose: Lower-bound structural initialization with the exact matched starting count and downstream schedule.

comparators.label: Splat-SfM initialization
comparators.purpose: Calibrated structure-from-splats using only the frozen 2D Gaussian fields; explicitly not COLMAP or Original 3DGS.

comparators.label: Beam Fusion initialization
comparators.purpose: Unmodified tomographic initializer whose known problems remain visible under the same downstream fit.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact pixel risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: Report every view and seed, then the per-frame median and paired median over frames.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact area risk
primary_metrics.aggregation: Report every view and seed, then the per-frame median and paired median over frames.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out compact risk curve area
primary_metrics.aggregation: Trapezoidal checkpoint AUC per seed and frame, with all raw trajectories retained.

primary_metrics.label: Final Gaussian count
primary_metrics.aggregation: Report each cell and the number of clone, split, prune, and opacity-reset events.

primary_metrics.label: Frozen Stage-1 foreground fit PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: Pre-reconstruction acquisition QA only; report each view and equal-view frame means.

primary_metrics.label: Peak CUDA allocated
primary_metrics.aggregation: Fresh-process raw repeats and paired medians by arm, seed, and frame.

primary_metrics.label: Reconstruction wall time
primary_metrics.aggregation: Initializer and optimizer stages separately, retaining every raw repeat.

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh image-free process from strict compact-manifest load through final 3D Gaussian save; Stage-1 acquisition and any later RGB presentation rendering are separate receipts.
resource_protocol.aggregation: Paired median on the same idle RTX 4090 with every raw repeat, min/max, background allocation, and failure retained.

blockers: Add and freeze one canonical fresh-process run command that executes every reviewed frame, seed, and arm cell and produces the contract result bundle without overwriting development outputs.
Obtain an outcome-unseen prospective protocol review before init-run; do not inspect official arm outcomes while reviewing.
Splat-SfM is the executable field-derived structure arm. A conventional COLMAP SfM arm remains unavailable and must not be implied by labels or claims.
